## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 3 sept. 2026 - 14 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _K_, 14 oct. 2026, 1/5: "After months of use the app suddenly changed and blocked all but 4 of my entries behind a paywall. Can't check, see or interact with them. Crazy work, but glad since it finally made me switch. App was always clunky, slow and stuttery but after setting everything up I didn't want to switch. bye"
            2. _Cara M_, 3 sept. 2026, 3/5: "Too much behind a paywall."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      3 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 21 juil. 2026 - 14 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _K_, 14 oct. 2026, 1/5: "After months of use the app suddenly changed and blocked all but 4 of my entries behind a paywall. Can't check, see or interact with them. Crazy work, but glad since it finally made me switch. App was always clunky, slow and stuttery but after setting everything up I didn't want to switch. bye"
            2. _divyang bargali_, 20 sept. 2026, 1/5: "so many bugs and issues un the app."
            3. _Andraev Reese Artamonov Fernandez_, 21 juil. 2026, 3/5: "I love the app, but lately I have been having issues to mark the habits that need multiple points, it does not register and I have to do it multiple times, is really annoying"
